description: side view 2D pixel art game scene: a tiny cute but fierce chibi SD kaiju stomping through a miniature city street. The kaiju is an original stone-age lava dinosaur standing upright: very chunky round body, huge heavy head, big round belly, short thick legs, tiny arms, dark grey-green volcanic rock skin with thin glowing orange lava cracks, a row of big jagged black obsidian spikes along its back and long tail with glowing orange tips, a round rock club at the end of the tail, small blunt horn on the nose, angry glowing yellow eyes. It faces right with one foot raised to stomp. Tiny toy-like colourful city buildings around it, about two thirds of its height, one building crumbling with dust and flying bricks, cracked road, bright blue sky with soft clouds, bold dark outlines, vivid colours, clean crisp pixel art
